title: Trees Talk Through An Underground Internet 🌲 #shorts #nature #science
description: Beneath the forest floor, trees share nutrients and communicate through a fungal network. #shorts #trees #forest #biology
text: Trees in a forest are secretly talking to each other and sharing food through a massive underground internet. Beneath the soil lies the mycorrhizal network, a vast web of fungal threads connecting tree root systems across entire forests. Through this subterranean web, mother trees send nutrients to struggling seedlings, nurse sick neighbors, and release chemical warning signals when attacked by pests. title: The Coldest Place In The Universe Is On Earth ❄️ #shorts #science #space
description: Deep space is not the coldest place in the cosmos. It's inside a laboratory on Earth. #shorts #physics #quantum #universe
text: The coldest place in the entire known universe is not in deep space. It is inside an ordinary physics laboratory on Earth. Natural deep space hovers around minus four hundred and fifty-five degrees Fahrenheit. But inside physics laboratories, scientists use lasers to cool clouds of atoms to less than one billionth of a degree above absolute zero, colder than anywhere in the natural cosmos. title: Why You Should Never Insult A Crow 🐦‍⬛ #shorts #animals #nature

text: Right this second, over two thousand thunderstorms are roaring simultaneously across the planet Earth. title: Your Stomach Acid Can Melt Razor Blades 🧪 #shorts #humanbody #science
description: Your stomach acid is as corrosive as battery acid and can dissolve stainless steel. #shorts #anatomy #biology #mindblown
text: The acid inside your stomach is potent enough to completely dissolve a stainless steel razor blade. Your stomach produces hydrochloric acid with a pH level between one and two, which is as corrosive as battery acid. In clinical laboratory tests, stomach acid dissolved the thickened blade of a single-edge razor in under twenty-four hours. Your stomach only survives because it secretes a protective mucus lining. description: Every planet, moon, and asteroid combined makes up less than 0.2% of the solar system's mass. #shorts #sun #universe #solarsystem
text: If you weighed everything in the entire solar system together, all the planets combined would weigh almost nothing.
